name: Monodam
source:
The member of the Monokubs who closed his heart because of [url=/c54405]Monokid’s[/url] bullying. For the most part he doesn’t speak to his fellow siblings/members. His unique point is his robotic-looking body.

[From [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/154469818636/ndrv3-famitsu-info-for-december-15th-2016]jinjojess' translation[/url]]
